newsitem.title: MALTA: Market turnover up at Malta exchange.
newsitem.headline: Market turnover up at Malta exchange.

text.p: Turnover was up at the once-weekly trading session of the Malta stock exchange on Wednesday, reaching just under 1.4 million Maltese pounds ($3.6 million) from the previous week's 480,500 pounds.
The share index rose just over two points to close at 1000.55.
Business was spread over 127 deals, of which 55 were in equities and 72 in fixed income securities.

Equity turnover reached 105,000 pounds, with 81,830 shares being traded. Most of them, 73,000, were Bank of Valletta shares transacted in 45 deals for an average price of 125.8 cents per share, up four mils.
There was only one deal in Mid-Med Bank with 2,400 shares changing hands for an average 155 cents, up just over one cent.
In Middle Sea Insurance, 6,250 shares were traded for an average 122 cents per share, unchanged.
In government bonds, 22 issues were dealt in, with turnover amounting to just under 1.27 million pounds. Business was mainly in the 7.25 percent MGS 2006 (III) and the 6.35 percent MGS 1998 (I).

In corporate bonds, there were three deals in Mid-Med Bank 7.25 percent unsecured loan stock 2005, one deal in 6.5 percent Gasan bonds 1998/99 and two deals in 8.25 percent Suncrest Bonds 2005/7 amounting to 7,095 pounds, 1,960 pounds and 4,003 pounds respectively.
